$comment: Atlas Search (full-text) index for the `documents` collection.
Serves browse substring search: the `search` parameter on `list_sources`,
keywordLowercase analyzer indexes each field's whole value as a single
lowercased term, so a `wildcard` query delivers the case-insensitive
substring semantics the API promises while staying on the index — a
case-insensitive $regex can never use one. The `token` mapping on `title`
and the date/number fields exist for the $search `sort` option.
Applied as code by `npm run db:indexes` — see chunks.vector.json.
